name: Laser Level Pro3 Multipurpose Tool | Vertical, Cross Line & Measuring Tape with Rulers
description:
The Laser Level Pro3 LV03 is a versatile 4-in-1 tool designed for precision alignment and measurement. It combines a laser alignment system, dual rulers, and a 2.5-meter measuring tape in one compact device. With straight, cross, and solid laser line modes, plus bubble vials for added accuracy, it ensures flawless results whether you’re hanging pictures, tiling, or installing shelves. Lightweight and portable, it’s powered by included AG13 batteries for instant use.
Key Features
 4-in-1 design: laser, rulers, tape, and bubble levels
 Projects straight, cross, and corner laser lines
 Built-in 2.5m measuring tape with lock
 Dual metric and imperial ruler markings
 Lightweight, portable design with magnetic base option
 Comes ready to use with batteries included
Ingredients / Materials
Material: ABS plastic
Laser type: Straight, cross, solid line projection
Tape length: 2.5 meters (8 feet)
Power: 3 × AG13 button cell batteries (included)
How to Use
 Insert the batteries into the compartment
 Switch on the laser to select desired line mode
 Use the tape measure or rulers for accurate measurement
 Align objects with the help of bubble levels
 Attach to magnetic surfaces (if using base) for stability
Package Includes
 1 × Laser Level LV03
 3 × AG13 Button Cell Batteries
